import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('image.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B = im[:,:,0], im[:,:,1], im[:,:,2]
yellow = (R>165)&(G>135)&(B<115)&((R-B)>85)&((G-B)>55)
tan = (R>185)&(G>165)&(B>125)&(B<210)&((R-B)>30)&((R-B)<100)&((G-B)>12)

def analyze(mask, P1, P2, xlim, ylim, label, bins=20):
    P1=np.array(P1,float); P2=np.array(P2,float)
    d = (P2-P1); d/= np.linalg.norm(d)
    p = np.array([-d[1], d[0]])
    ys,xs = np.nonzero(mask)
    keep = (xs>=xlim[0])&(xs<=xlim[1])&(ys>=ylim[0])&(ys<=ylim[1])
    xs,ys = xs[keep], ys[keep]
    pts = np.stack([xs,ys],1).astype(float)
    t = (pts-P1)@d
    s = (pts-P1)@p
    t0,t1 = t.min(), t.max()
    print(f'--- {label}  t range {t0:.0f}..{t1:.0f}  n={len(pts)}')
    edges = np.linspace(t0,t1,bins+1)
    for i in range(bins):
        m = (t>=edges[i])&(t<edges[i+1])
        if m.sum()<80: continue
        sm = s[m].mean()
        # weight by pixels; report mean signed offset
        print(f'  t={edges[i]:6.0f}-{edges[i+1]:6.0f} n={m.sum():5d} meanS={sm:7.1f} fracLeft={(s[m]>0).mean():.2f}')

# MODEL: axis through crankshaft. Estimate: top end near (430,110), bottom end near (880,830)
analyze(yellow, (430,110), (880,830), (250,1100), (50,1050), 'MODEL yellow', 16)
analyze(tan,    (430,110), (880,830), (250,1100), (50,1050), 'MODEL tan', 16)
# DIAGRAM region: axis from diagram top yellow disc to diagram bottom
analyze(yellow, (300,760), (660,1060), (130,720), (620,1130), 'DIAGRAM yellow', 14)
analyze(tan,    (300,760), (660,1060), (130,720), (620,1130), 'DIAGRAM tan', 14)
EOF
